verdict.rationale: Kit's broadcasts API documents drafting or scheduling a broadcast to all or a subset of subscribers, with audiences targeted by segment or tag IDs. Pricing lists unlimited broadcasts plus audience tagging and segmentation. Composition is supported by Kit's email editors (brand colors, collaborative editing), and broadcast stats expose sending status and progress. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the email composition/editor experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the send/schedule loop.
